wrap_string_to_width: wrap a string to a specified width using textwrap fill for each line
truncate_string_by_length: truncate a string to a maximum length and remove specified delimiters
wrap_multiline_text: wrap each line of a multiline string to a given column width
truncate_with_delimiter: truncate a string at a max length and split on a delimiter to remove it
summarize_wrap_function: summarize the wrap function which wraps text lines to a specified width
